notes: Instantiation (b) of architect-editor-pair for copilot: a plan→implement MODE pair (one model) captured across the approval gate, asserting the FULL arc ready→working→waiting→working→ready on ONE live copilot session. The architect/plan phase is Copilot plan mode (entered with the documented `--plan` launch flag); the agent calls its builtin `exit_plan_mode` tool, which BLOCKS on an approve/reject picker — the plan_gate. The user approves, the mode flips to interactive, the agent applies a REAL edit (creating calc.py) and the turn completes → ready. NOT the Aider two-models-in-one-turn shape: this account cannot pin a model (the hydra router resolves once per session and only the literal `auto` is accepted), so one model runs throughout — the same relaxation the claudecode and codex sibling specs make. KNOWN FAILING, and the spec deliberately asserts the CORRECT behavior rather than the buggy one: the gate DOES leave an on-disk trace (an open tool.execution_start{toolName:"exit_plan_mode"} — Copilot writes a blocking tool's start line at dispatch and leaves it open for the whole wait, measured at 35s for a bash call in the live 1.0.77 store), but the daemon's twin user-blocking name sets know only PascalCase ExitPlanMode (core/pkg/tailer/tailer_config.go:44 and core/domain/session/metrics.go:450, an exact match), so NeedsUserAttention stays false and the session reads `working` across the gate. The plan_gate and waiting_dwell phases fail until `exit_plan_mode` is added to BOTH sets; every other phase should pass. PRESESSION shape: copilot creates the session-state directory at launch with only workspace.yaml and writes events.jsonl on the first prompt, so a transient proc-<PID> row is born before the real session (id = the directory name) reconciles under a DIFFERENT session_id — every post-birth phase anchors to the REAL session. Two prose-asserted signals verified at record time (the phase DSL has no token or model field): SessionMetrics.TotalTokens after turn_end > at plan_gate, and ModelName is a single consistent value across both phases. observations pin `agent` and non-zero cost/tokens (the arc runs through assistant.turn_end and a usage checkpoint, unlike 2-19 which dies mid-turn); `model` is left provisional for record to fill, because the auto-router picks it and this account cannot pin one.
